paragraphs.text: And after these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Judaea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα περιεπάτει ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ, οὐ γὰρ ἤθελεν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ περιπατεῖν, ὅτι ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἀποκτεῖναι.
paragraphs.translit: Kai meta tauta periepatei ho Iēsous en tē Galilaia, ou gar ēthelen en tē Ioudaia peripatein, hoti ezētoun auton hoi Ioudaioi apokteinai.

paragraphs.text: Now the feast of the Jews, the feast of tabernacles, was at hand.
paragraphs.original: ἦν δὲ ἐγγὺς ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἡ σκηνοπηγία.
paragraphs.translit: ēn de engys hē heortē tōn Ioudaiōn hē skēnopēgia.

paragraphs.text: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may behold thy works which thou doest.
paragraphs.original: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ· Μετάβηθι ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ὕπαγε εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν, ἵνα καὶ οἱ μαθηταί σου θεωρήσουσιν σοῦ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιεῖς·
paragraphs.translit: eipon oun pros auton hoi adelphoi autou· Metabēthi enteuthen kai hypage eis tēn Ioudaian, hina kai hoi mathētai sou theōrēsousin sou ta erga ha poieis·

paragraphs.text: For no man doeth anything in secret, and himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou doest these things, manifest thyself to the world.
paragraphs.original: οὐδεὶς γάρ τι ἐν κρυπτῷ ποιεῖ καὶ ζητεῖ αὐτὸς ἐν παρρησίᾳ εἶναι· εἰ ταῦτα ποιεῖς, φανέρωσον σεαυτὸν τῷ κόσμῳ.
paragraphs.translit: oudeis gar ti en kryptō poiei kai zētei autos en parrēsia einai· ei tauta poieis, phanerōson seauton tō kosmō.

paragraphs.text: For even his brethren did not believe on him.
paragraphs.original: οὐδὲ γὰρ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπίστευον εἰς αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: oude gar hoi adelphoi autou episteuon eis auton.

paragraphs.text: Jesus therefore saith unto them, My time is not yet come; but your time is always ready.
paragraphs.original: λέγει οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὁ καιρὸς ὁ ἐμὸς οὔπω πάρεστιν, ὁ δὲ καιρὸς ὁ ὑμέτερος πάντοτέ ἐστιν ἕτοιμος.
paragraphs.translit: legei oun autois ho Iēsous· Ho kairos ho emos oupō parestin, ho de kairos ho hymeteros pantote estin hetoimos.

paragraphs.text: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that its works are evil.
paragraphs.original: οὐ δύναται ὁ κόσμος μισεῖν ὑμᾶς, ἐμὲ δὲ μισεῖ, ὅτι ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ πονηρά ἐστιν.
paragraphs.translit: ou dynatai ho kosmos misein hymas, eme de misei, hoti egō martyrō peri autou hoti ta erga autou ponēra estin.

paragraphs.text: Go ye up unto the feast: I go not up unto this feast; because my time is not yet fulfilled.
paragraphs.original: ὑμεῖς ἀνάβητε εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν· ἐγὼ οὐκ ἀναβαίνω εἰς τὴν ἑορτὴν ταύτην, ὅτι ὁ ἐμὸς καιρὸς οὔπω πεπλήρωται.
paragraphs.translit: hymeis anabēte eis tēn heortēn· egō ouk anabainō eis tēn heortēn tautēn, hoti ho emos kairos oupō peplērōtai.

paragraphs.text: And having said these things unto them, he abode [still] in Galilee.
paragraphs.original: ταῦτα δὲ εἰπὼν αὐτὸς ἔμεινεν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ.
paragraphs.translit: tauta de eipōn autos emeinen en tē Galilaia.

paragraphs.text: But when his brethren were gone up unto the feast, then went he also up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
paragraphs.original: Ὡς δὲ ἀνέβησαν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν, τότε καὶ αὐτὸς ἀνέβη, οὐ φανερῶς ἀλλὰ ὡς ἐν κρυπτῷ.
paragraphs.translit: Hōs de anebēsan hoi adelphoi autou eis tēn heortēn, tote kai autos anebē, ou phanerōs alla hōs en kryptō.

paragraphs.text: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
paragraphs.original: οἱ οὖν Ἰουδαῖοι ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ καὶ ἔλεγον· Ποῦ ἐστιν ἐκεῖνος;
paragraphs.translit: hoi oun Ioudaioi ezētoun auton en tē heortē kai elegon· Pou estin ekeinos;

paragraphs.text: And there was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him: some said, He is a good man; others said, Not so, but he leadeth the multitude astray.
paragraphs.original: καὶ γογγυσμὸς περὶ αὐτοῦ ἦν πολὺς ἐν τοῖς ὄχλοις· οἱ μὲν ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἀγαθός ἐστιν, ἄλλοι δὲ ἔλεγον· Οὔ, ἀλλὰ πλανᾷ τὸν ὄχλον.
paragraphs.translit: kai gongysmos peri autou ēn polys en tois ochlois· hoi men elegon hoti Agathos estin, alloi de elegon· Ou, alla plana ton ochlon.

paragraphs.text: Yet no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
paragraphs.original: οὐδεὶς μέντοι παρρησίᾳ ἐλάλει περὶ αὐτοῦ διὰ τὸν φόβον τῶν Ἰουδαίων.
paragraphs.translit: oudeis mentoi parrēsia elalei peri autou dia ton phobon tōn Ioudaiōn.

paragraphs.text: But when it was now the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
paragraphs.original: Ἤδη δὲ τῆς ἑορτῆς μεσούσης ἀνέβη Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ ἐδίδασκεν.
paragraphs.translit: Ēdē de tēs heortēs mesousēs anebē Iēsous eis to hieron kai edidasken.

paragraphs.text: The Jews therefore marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
paragraphs.original: ἐθαύμαζον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι λέγοντες· Πῶς οὗτος γράμματα οἶδεν μὴ μεμαθηκώς;
paragraphs.translit: ethaumazon oun hoi Ioudaioi legontes· Pōs houtos grammata oiden mē memathēkōs;

paragraphs.text: Jesus therefore answered them and said, My teaching is not mine, but his that sent me.
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθη οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν· Ἡ ἐμὴ διδαχὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὴ ἀλλὰ τοῦ πέμψαντός με·
paragraphs.translit: apekrithē oun autois ho Iēsous kai eipen· Hē emē didachē ouk estin emē alla tou pempsantos me·

paragraphs.text: If any man willeth to do his will, he shall know of the teaching, whether it is of God, or [whether] I speak from myself.
paragraphs.original: ἐάν τις θέλῃ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ποιεῖν, γνώσεται περὶ τῆς διδαχῆς πότερον ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν ἢ ἐγὼ ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ λαλῶ.
paragraphs.translit: ean tis thelē to thelēma autou poiein, gnōsetai peri tēs didachēs poteron ek tou theou estin ē egō apʼ emautou lalō.

paragraphs.text: He that speaketh from himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh the glory of him that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
paragraphs.original: ὁ ἀφʼ ἑαυτοῦ λαλῶν τὴν δόξαν τὴν ἰδίαν ζητεῖ· ὁ δὲ ζητῶν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ πέμψαντος αὐτὸν οὗτος ἀληθής ἐστιν καὶ ἀδικία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν.
paragraphs.translit: ho aphʼ heautou lalōn tēn doxan tēn idian zētei· ho de zētōn tēn doxan tou pempsantos auton houtos alēthēs estin kai adikia en autō ouk estin.

paragraphs.text: Did not Moses give you the law, and [yet] none of you doeth the law? Why seek ye to kill me?
paragraphs.original: Οὐ Μωϋσῆς δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὸν νόμον; καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ποιεῖ τὸν νόμον. τί με ζητεῖτε ἀποκτεῖναι;
paragraphs.translit: Ou Mōysēs dedōken hymin ton nomon; kai oudeis ex hymōn poiei ton nomon. ti me zēteite apokteinai;

paragraphs.text: The multitude answered, Thou hast a demon: who seeketh to kill thee?
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ ὄχλος· Δαιμόνιον ἔχεις· τίς σε ζητεῖ ἀποκτεῖναι;
paragraphs.translit: apekrithē ho ochlos· Daimonion echeis· tis se zētei apokteinai;

paragraphs.text: Jesus answered and said unto them, I did one work, and ye all marvel because thereof.
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἓν ἔργον ἐποίησα καὶ πάντες θαυμάζετε.
paragraphs.translit: apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autois· Hen ergon epoiēsa kai pantes thaumazete.

paragraphs.text: Moses hath given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers); and on the sabbath ye circumcise a man.
paragraphs.original: διὰ τοῦτο Μωϋσῆς δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὴν περιτομήν— οὐχ ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ Μωϋσέως ἐστὶν ἀλλʼ ἐκ τῶν πατέρων— καὶ ἐν σαββάτῳ περιτέμνετε ἄνθρωπον.
paragraphs.translit: dia touto Mōysēs dedōken hymin tēn peritomēn— ouch hoti ek tou Mōyseōs estin allʼ ek tōn paterōn— kai en sabbatō peritemnete anthrōpon.

paragraphs.text: If a man receiveth circumcision on the sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken; are ye wroth with me, because I made a man every whit whole on the sabbath?
paragraphs.original: εἰ περιτομὴν λαμβάνει ἄνθρωπος ἐν σαββάτῳ ἵνα μὴ λυθῇ ὁ νόμος Μωϋσέως, ἐμοὶ χολᾶτε ὅτι ὅλον ἄνθρωπον ὑγιῆ ἐποίησα ἐν σαββάτῳ;
paragraphs.translit: ei peritomēn lambanei anthrōpos en sabbatō hina mē lythē ho nomos Mōyseōs, emoi cholate hoti holon anthrōpon hygiē epoiēsa en sabbatō;

paragraphs.text: Judge not according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
paragraphs.original: μὴ κρίνετε κατʼ ὄψιν, ἀλλὰ τὴν δικαίαν κρίσιν κρίνετε.
paragraphs.translit: mē krinete katʼ opsin, alla tēn dikaian krisin krinete.

paragraphs.text: Some therefore of them of Jerusalem said, Is not this he whom they seek to kill?
paragraphs.original: Ἔλεγον οὖν τινες ἐκ τῶν Ἱεροσολυμιτῶν· Οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὃν ζητοῦσιν ἀποκτεῖναι;
paragraphs.translit: Elegon oun tines ek tōn Hierosolymitōn· Ouch houtos estin hon zētousin apokteinai;

paragraphs.text: And lo, he speaketh openly, and they say nothing unto him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is the Christ?
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἴδε παρρησίᾳ λαλεῖ καὶ οὐδὲν αὐτῷ λέγουσιν· μήποτε ἀληθῶς ἔγνωσαν οἱ ἄρχοντες ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ χριστός;
paragraphs.translit: kai ide parrēsia lalei kai ouden autō legousin· mēpote alēthōs egnōsan hoi archontes hoti houtos estin ho christos;

paragraphs.text: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when the Christ cometh, no one knoweth whence he is.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ τοῦτον οἴδαμεν πόθεν ἐστίν· ὁ δὲ χριστὸς ὅταν ἔρχηται οὐδεὶς γινώσκει πόθεν ἐστίν.
paragraphs.translit: alla touton oidamen pothen estin· ho de christos hotan erchētai oudeis ginōskei pothen estin.

paragraphs.text: Jesus therefore cried in the temple, teaching and saying, Ye both know me, and know whence I am; and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
paragraphs.original: ἔκραξεν οὖν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ λέγων· Κἀμὲ οἴδατε καὶ οἴδατε πόθεν εἰμί· καὶ ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐκ ἐλήλυθα, ἀλλʼ ἔστιν ἀληθινὸς ὁ πέμψας με, ὃν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε·
paragraphs.translit: ekraxen oun en tō hierō didaskōn ho Iēsous kai legōn· Kame oidate kai oidate pothen eimi· kai apʼ emautou ouk elēlytha, allʼ estin alēthinos ho pempsas me, hon hymeis ouk oidate·

paragraphs.text: I know him; because I am from him, and he sent me.
paragraphs.original: ἐγὼ οἶδα αὐτόν, ὅτι παρʼ αὐτοῦ εἰμι κἀκεῖνός με ἀπέστειλεν.
paragraphs.translit: egō oida auton, hoti parʼ autou eimi kakeinos me apesteilen.

paragraphs.text: They sought therefore to take him: and no man laid his hand on him, because his hour was not yet come.
paragraphs.original: ἐζήτουν οὖν αὐτὸν πιάσαι, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπέβαλεν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τὴν χεῖρα, ὅτι οὔπω ἐληλύθει ἡ ὥρα αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ezētoun oun auton piasai, kai oudeis epebalen epʼ auton tēn cheira, hoti oupō elēlythei hē hōra autou.

paragraphs.text: But of the multitude many believed on him; and they said, When the Christ shall come, will he do more signs than those which this man hath done?
paragraphs.original: ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου δὲ πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν, καὶ ἔλεγον· Ὁ χριστὸς ὅταν ἔλθῃ μὴ πλείονα σημεῖα ποιήσει ὧν οὗτος ἐποίησεν;
paragraphs.translit: ek tou ochlou de polloi episteusan eis auton, kai elegon· Ho christos hotan elthē mē pleiona sēmeia poiēsei hōn houtos epoiēsen;

paragraphs.text: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him; and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to take him.
paragraphs.original: Ἤκουσαν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι τοῦ ὄχλου γογγύζοντος περὶ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα, καὶ ἀπέστειλαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ὑπηρέτας ἵνα πιάσωσιν αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: Ēkousan hoi Pharisaioi tou ochlou gongyzontos peri autou tauta, kai apesteilan hoi archiereis kai hoi Pharisaioi hypēretas hina piasōsin auton.

paragraphs.text: Jesus therefore said, Yet a little while am I with you, and I go unto him that sent me.
paragraphs.original: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἔτι χρόνον μικρὸν μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰμι καὶ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με.
paragraphs.translit: eipen oun ho Iēsous· Eti chronon mikron methʼ hymōn eimi kai hypagō pros ton pempsanta me.

paragraphs.text: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, ye cannot come.
paragraphs.original: ζητήσετέ με καὶ οὐχ εὑρήσετε, καὶ ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: zētēsete me kai ouch heurēsete, kai hopou eimi egō hymeis ou dynasthe elthein.

paragraphs.text: The Jews therefore said among themselves, Whither will this man go that we shall not find him? will he go unto the Dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
paragraphs.original: εἶπον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι πρὸς ἑαυτούς· Ποῦ οὗτος μέλλει πορεύεσθαι ὅτι ἡμεῖς οὐχ εὑρήσομεν αὐτόν; μὴ εἰς τὴν διασπορὰν τῶν Ἑλλήνων μέλλει πορεύεσθαι καὶ διδάσκειν τοὺς Ἕλληνας;
paragraphs.translit: eipon oun hoi Ioudaioi pros heautous· Pou houtos mellei poreuesthai hoti hēmeis ouch heurēsomen auton; mē eis tēn diasporan tōn Hellēnōn mellei poreuesthai kai didaskein tous Hellēnas;

paragraphs.text: What is this word that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me; and where I am, ye cannot come?
paragraphs.original: τίς ἐστιν ὁ λόγος οὗτος ὃν εἶπε· Ζητήσετέ με καὶ οὐχ εὑρήσετε, καὶ ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν;
paragraphs.translit: tis estin ho logos houtos hon eipe· Zētēsete me kai ouch heurēsete, kai hopou eimi egō hymeis ou dynasthe elthein;

paragraphs.text: Now on the last day, the great [day] of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me and drink.
paragraphs.original: Ἐν δὲ τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ μεγάλῃ τῆς ἑορτῆς εἱστήκει ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἔκραξεν λέγων· Ἐάν τις διψᾷ ἐρχέσθω πρός με καὶ πινέτω.
paragraphs.translit: En de tē eschatē hēmera tē megalē tēs heortēs heistēkei ho Iēsous, kai ekraxen legōn· Ean tis dipsa erchesthō pros me kai pinetō.

paragraphs.text: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, from within him shall flow rivers of living water.
paragraphs.original: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμέ, καθὼς εἶπεν ἡ γραφή, ποταμοὶ ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας αὐτοῦ ῥεύσουσιν ὕδατος ζῶντος.
paragraphs.translit: ho pisteuōn eis eme, kathōs eipen hē graphē, potamoi ek tēs koilias autou rheusousin hydatos zōntos.

paragraphs.text: But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believed on him were to receive: for the Spirit was not yet [given]; because Jesus was not yet glorified.
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο δὲ εἶπεν περὶ τοῦ πνεύματος οὗ ἔμελλον λαμβάνειν οἱ πιστεύσαντες εἰς αὐτόν· οὔπω γὰρ ἦν πνεῦμα, ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐδέπω ἐδοξάσθη.
paragraphs.translit: touto de eipen peri tou pneumatos hou emellon lambanein hoi pisteusantes eis auton· oupō gar ēn pneuma, hoti Iēsous oudepō edoxasthē.

paragraphs.text: [Some] of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, This is of a truth the prophet.
paragraphs.original: Ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου οὖν ἀκούσαντες τῶν λόγων τούτων ἔλεγον· Οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ προφήτης·
paragraphs.translit: Ek tou ochlou oun akousantes tōn logōn toutōn elegon· Houtos estin alēthōs ho prophētēs·

paragraphs.text: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, What, doth the Christ come out of Galilee?
paragraphs.original: ἄλλοι ἔλεγον· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ χριστός· οἱ δὲ ἔλεγον· Μὴ γὰρ ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ὁ χριστὸς ἔρχεται;
paragraphs.translit: alloi elegon· Houtos estin ho christos· hoi de elegon· Mē gar ek tēs Galilaias ho christos erchetai;

paragraphs.text: Hath not the scripture said that the Christ cometh of the seed of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?
paragraphs.original: οὐχ ἡ γραφὴ εἶπεν ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος Δαυίδ, καὶ ἀπὸ Βηθλέεμ τῆς κώμης ὅπου ἦν Δαυίδ, ἔρχεται ὁ χριστός;
paragraphs.translit: ouch hē graphē eipen hoti ek tou spermatos Dauid, kai apo Bēthleem tēs kōmēs hopou ēn Dauid, erchetai ho christos;

paragraphs.text: So there arose a division in the multitude because of him.
paragraphs.original: σχίσμα οὖν ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ διʼ αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: schisma oun egeneto en tō ochlō diʼ auton.

paragraphs.text: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
paragraphs.original: τινὲς δὲ ἤθελον ἐξ αὐτῶν πιάσαι αὐτόν, ἀλλʼ οὐδεὶς ἐπέβαλεν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τὰς χεῖρας.
paragraphs.translit: tines de ēthelon ex autōn piasai auton, allʼ oudeis epebalen epʼ auton tas cheiras.

paragraphs.text: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why did ye not bring him?
paragraphs.original: Ἦλθον οὖν οἱ ὑπηρέται πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ Φαρισαίους, καὶ εἶπον αὐτοῖς ἐκεῖνοι· Διὰ τί οὐκ ἠγάγετε αὐτόν;
paragraphs.translit: Ēlthon oun hoi hypēretai pros tous archiereis kai Pharisaious, kai eipon autois ekeinoi· Dia ti ouk ēgagete auton;

paragraphs.text: The officers answered, Never man so spake.
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ ὑπηρέται· Οὐδέποτε ἐλάλησεν οὕτως ἄνθρωπος.
paragraphs.translit: apekrithēsan hoi hypēretai· Oudepote elalēsen houtōs anthrōpos.

paragraphs.text: The Pharisees therefore answered them, Are ye also led astray?
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν οὖν αὐτοῖς οἱ Φαρισαῖοι· Μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς πεπλάνησθε;
paragraphs.translit: apekrithēsan oun autois hoi Pharisaioi· Mē kai hymeis peplanēsthe;

paragraphs.text: Hath any of the rulers believed on him, or of the Pharisees?
paragraphs.original: μή τις ἐκ τῶν ἀρχόντων ἐπίστευσεν εἰς αὐτὸν ἢ ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων;
paragraphs.translit: mē tis ek tōn archontōn episteusen eis auton ē ek tōn Pharisaiōn;

paragraphs.text: But this multitude that knoweth not the law are accursed.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ ὁ ὄχλος οὗτος ὁ μὴ γινώσκων τὸν νόμον ἐπάρατοί εἰσιν.
paragraphs.translit: alla ho ochlos houtos ho mē ginōskōn ton nomon eparatoi eisin.

paragraphs.text: Nicodemus saith unto them (he that came to him before, being one of them),
paragraphs.original: λέγει Νικόδημος πρὸς αὐτούς, ὁ ἐλθὼν πρὸς αὐτὸν πρότερον, εἷς ὢν ἐξ αὐτῶν·
paragraphs.translit: legei Nikodēmos pros autous, ho elthōn pros auton proteron, heis ōn ex autōn·

paragraphs.text: Doth our law judge a man, except it first hear from himself and know what he doeth?
paragraphs.original: Μὴ ὁ νόμος ἡμῶν κρίνει τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἐὰν μὴ ἀκούσῃ πρῶτον παρʼ αὐτοῦ καὶ γνῷ τί ποιεῖ;
paragraphs.translit: Mē ho nomos hēmōn krinei ton anthrōpon ean mē akousē prōton parʼ autou kai gnō ti poiei;

paragraphs.text: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and see that out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Μὴ καὶ σὺ ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶ; ἐραύνησον καὶ ἴδε ὅτι ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας προφήτης οὐκ ἐγείρεται.
paragraphs.translit: apekrithēsan kai eipan autō· Mē kai sy ek tēs Galilaias ei; eraunēson kai ide hoti ek tēs Galilaias prophētēs ouk egeiretai.

paragraphs.text: And they went every man unto his own house:
paragraphs.original: ⟦καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἕκαστος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: ⟦kai eporeuthē hekastos eis ton oikon autou·
